summary: Tested ClassOS Phase 1 end-to-end. Backend: 11 pytest cases (health, classes/current, full session lifecycle for real+demo, 404/422 error handling) - all passed. Frontend: Start Class render, Demo flow (connecting->live->processing->Results), Real flow with microphone permission GRANTED (via context.grant_permissions), microphone DENIED error path with retry, Results 'Back to start', mobile 390x844 layout. All flows passed. Confirmed NO scripted/sample transcript text anywhere in Real Mode live screen (only timer, 'Recording · microphone active', and the honest note 'No transcript yet — this phase only records the session.').

minor.issue: No status guard: end can be called on an already-complete session (overwrites status back to 'processing'), and finalize can be called on a 'live' session skipping end. Not user-reachable from current UI, but consider state validation.
Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (cosmetic REST nit).

issues: Content is a fixed narrow mobile-width column centered on desktop with large empty area below; intentional per mobile-first reference design, no contrast/spacing problems found.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers for future FastAPI versions.
Optional: add status transition validation in end_session/finalize_session so lifecycle cannot be replayed out of order.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST class_sessions documents in MongoDB via API lifecycle tests (no delete endpoint exists, so they remain; they are not surfaced by any UI list).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). For Real Mode UI testing in headless Chromium, use page.context.grant_permissions(['microphone'], origin=...) - real getUserMedia succeeds. For deny path, add_init_script overriding navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia to reject with NotAllowedError. Results status text renders lowercase 'complete' in the DOM and is uppercased via CSS (uppercase class) - assert case-insensitively.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; no RCA required.
